# benchmark-core

> Typed engine for AI benchmarks with SDK, CLI, MCP, and HTTP API surfaces.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-core
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-core
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com
README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-core#readme

## Main exports

defineBenchmark, run, score helpers, mockAdapter, openrouterAdapter, openaiCompatAdapter, runEpisode, replay, createCli, createMcpServer, createHandler, serve, renderCard, renderMarkdown, indexEntry, provenanceMarkdown, mulberry32, bootstrapCI.

## Environment

OPENROUTER_API_KEY selects OpenRouter. OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY select an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The mock adapter needs no key or network.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The end-to-end report is written to `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.

## Episode execution

Tasks declare `kind: "single" | "episode"`. Episode benchmarks provide a deterministic `Environment` and optional good/bad mock policies. `runEpisode` records a transcript, tool log, final state, cost, and abort reason. `replay` recomputes simulator state from a submitted trace without a model call.
